meaning: Complete resource-result and report consistency accepted, not new-method quality success.
scope: Read only already-complete local resource evidence and reports. Checked existing peaks, unit conversions, layout, cost fields, original public-generation invariants and saved completion observation.
No model load, scoring, bootstrap, remote access, checkpoint payload hashing, configuration selection or README modification.
supported: The new proof fills the resource gap for the actually sealed strongest-Qwen formal checkpoint without changing its quality result.
Five raw-input-matched same-card windows show a lower measured peak for the completed LLaVA plain-r8 graph, while keeping native prepared/tokenization differences explicit.
FINDINGS and OUTCOME accurately report parameter/buffer/container distinctions and the measured scalar ranges.
The proposed Qwen formal-table value4954.604MiB is the rounded maximum of this original formal checkpoint five-window measurement; a fixed-window footnote is necessary.
limits: Original Qwen is FP16-base plus FP32-LoRA without fold; OneVision reference is folded. This is not an equally folded optimal-deployment or pure-architecture causal comparison.
Five32-token windows are not fullTEST worst-case peak, CPU RSS, NVML, latency or throughput.
Fewer native visual tokens do not by themselves imply lower whole-model GPU peak; no cause is identified from these counts.
Lower OneVision resources arise across different pretrained backbones/representations and are not a new structural innovation or evidence for the uncompleted ARC method.
The OneVision comparator is the explored FIT plain-r8 result. Its memory must not be reassigned to a formal Seq row or Ours; the Qwen formal resource row is supported by this exact formal checkpoint.
No quality or goal completion follows from this0-F1 measurement. Existing formal F1/AP/FWT/BWT, saved-state columns and FOREVER are outside the measured change and remain untouched.
